angleRead.text: I’m looking into Rockridge’s school quality index, which remains the highest in Oakland at 8.78, despite a slight dip from last cycle. Enrollment increased by one student, and I want to understand what’s driving families to choose Rockridge schools. The focus will be on the classroom environment, teacher quality, and how the community supports education.
